sources.publisher: Federal Ministry of Education, Department of Planning, Research and Development / NEMIS
sources.licence: Not stated in the document (government publication)
sources.limitations: Administrative (school census) data; known reporting errors incl. duplicated rows, implausible counts; population denominators are projections; public-school teacher tables only.
sources.permitted_uses: Research / non-commercial analysis with attribution; confirm terms with the Ministry before redistribution of raw tables.
sources.retrieval_method: Retrieved via web-fetch text extraction (the analysis sandbox network proxy blocks direct download from this host); values transcribed as printed into the raw CSV. The original PDF/JSON file could not be saved, so the checksum recorded is of the transcribed raw CSV. Transcription is verified by arithmetic/identity checks in the validation step.

sources.name: Nigeria Education Fact Sheets: Analyses for learning and equity using MICS data (MICS6 / MICS-EAGLE, 2021)
sources.publisher: UNICEF Nigeria with the National Bureau of Statistics
sources.documentation: Fact sheet pp. 27-33 (out-of-school rates); MICS6 full report https://www.unicef.org/nigeria/media/6316/file/2021%20MICS%20full%20report%20.pdf
sources.limitations: Household survey with sampling error (no CIs available in the extraction); the table text was scrambled by extraction: total/male/female columns aligned, urban/rural/wealth columns NOT reliably aligned. Report notes values were rounded down in Excel.
sources.retrieval_method: Retrieved via web-fetch text extraction (the analysis sandbox network proxy blocks direct download from this host); values transcribed as printed into the raw CSV. The original PDF/JSON file could not be saved, so the checksum recorded is of the transcribed raw CSV. Transcription is verified by arithmetic/identity checks in the validation step.
sources.national_table_note: National Table 3 (p.29) retrieved by web-fetch text extraction on 2026-10-22/23; rates are rounded to whole percentages as printed. Mother's-education rates are not provided in the table.
